svg.title: Which planets line up for us
svg.desc: Two groups of 200 Sun-like stars. If each has a hot Jupiter at 0.05 au, about 20 show transits. If each has an Earth twin at 1 au, only about 1 does.
svg.text: Each circle is a Sun-like star that has the planet. Filled: its orbit lines up, so we see transits.
